run.title: Product Research
assumptions: Product costs are estimates: supplier prices are starting prices before shipping
Ad counts only include ads that use the exact product words, so real numbers can be higher
Green on a map means we found nobody else selling this exact item there, not that nobody does
Lash adhesive is a cosmetic used near the eye: selling in the EU or UK needs a safety assessment and product registration

headline: Neither product is ready to test. The tennis swing trainer is the closer call: huge margin and only one advertiser, but cheap copies already sit in Amazon's top results everywhere.

products.name: Magnetic Tennis Swing Trainer (SwngPro)
products.one_liner: Only one brand advertises it and the margin is huge, but identical copies already sit in Amazon's top results in every country, from about US$30. Worth watching, not testing yet.
why: Swng runs 60+ ads and is ramping fast (36 started in October), with almost no other advertisers
A supplier sells it from about US$8, so roughly 90% of the US$89 price is left for ads and profit
But copies are easy to find: Amazon US result 3 at US$29.99, UK result 2 at £17, Germany result 1 at €45.99
products.risk: Swng's ads are only six weeks old, so they are not yet proof it pays, and Amazon copies undercut US$89 by two thirds.
next: Check again in early December: if Swng's late-August ads are still running, the ads pay
Then test it for padel or pickleball players, which Swng ignores: 3 short ads, about €20 a day for 5 days
products.best_region: None yet. Every country has a cheaper copy in Amazon's top results, and Walmart Canada lists one at CA$23.

snapshot.icp: Recreational tennis players, 25-55, who want to improve without paying for lessons
snapshot.job: Groove a consistent swing at home, with instant feedback
snapshot.cogs: About US$8 before shipping; roughly US$12-15 landed (estimate)
snapshot.claims: Audible snap when the swing is right; 5 resistance levels (11-33 N); 15-day drill program
snapshot.demoable: Yes: the snap sound on a good swing is made for short video

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: Walmart Canada lists the same stick at CA$23 (it may be a marketplace seller). No chain found elsewhere

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: Cheaper copies sit in Amazon's top 5 in every country, from £17 in the UK and €13 in Germany

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: One brand runs the ads; only one other page, which also sells SwngPro

angles: Padel players: the fastest-growing racket sport in Europe
Junior players: parents buying practice between lessons
Coaches and clubs: a set for group drills
TAKEN: "Win the match without lessons" (Swng's main message)

compare.note: The same chrome tube with a white grip and snap mechanism; Amazon sells the same design in other colours.

products.advertiser_takeaway: Swng is almost alone: 60+ ads, ramping fast since late August, and the only other page also sells SwngPro. That is the pattern to like, but it is only six weeks old, so it is not yet proof the ads pay.

category_notes.au: The chain listings are other tennis trainers (rebound balls, reflex sticks), not this stick.
category_notes.us: DICK'S sells other tennis trainers, not this stick; the copies are on Amazon.
category_notes.uk: Decathlon sells other tennis trainers, not this stick; the copy is on Amazon UK.
category_notes.de: Decathlon sells other tennis trainers, not this stick; the copies are on Amazon Germany.
category_notes.nz: Rebel Sport sells other tennis trainers, not this stick.

Advertisers.head: 1 brand, 60+ ads
Advertisers.detail: Swng runs all 60+ ads that name SwngPro, rising fast since late August. The only other page also sells SwngPro.

products.name: Pre-Glued Lash Starter Kit (Lola's Lashes)
products.store_products: 250 products, all lashes and lash care
products.one_liner: Nobody else sells this exact kit, so the map is green. But the category is full: big brands in every chain, 28+ advertisers and Amazon kits with thousands of reviews.
why: Ardell, KISS imPRESS and GLAM pre-glued clusters sit in Target, Walmart, Kmart, Priceline and Chemist Warehouse from about US$12
At least 28 brands advertise "pre-glued lashes"; Lola's alone runs 147 of 250 ads and has advertised since February
Amazon is heavy: 10,550+ bought last month in the US, and the top listing in Canada has 25,100 reviews
products.risk: You would need your own lash brand, safety paperwork and creative good enough to beat established beauty brands on cost per sale.
next: Skip this as a product test. If beauty appeals, look for a lash-care add-on (remover, storage, aftercare) with fewer advertisers
products.best_region: None. The map is green only because no one copies Lola's design; rival pre-glued kits are in big chains in all six countries.

snapshot.icp: Women 18-40 who want salon-style lash extensions without salon cost or infill appointments
snapshot.job: Fuller lashes at home that last several days
snapshot.cogs: Roughly £3-6 landed for a generic pre-glued kit (estimate, not checked)
snapshot.claims: 5-10 day hold, waterproof, patented stick-and-clamp applicator, vegan; Beauty Awards 2025 shortlist
snapshot.demoable: Yes: before and after, three-step application on camera

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: No chain sells a copy of this exact kit, but Superdrug and Boots stock Lola's own kit, and every chain sells rival pre-glued clusters

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: No other seller copies this exact design. The rival kits look clearly different, so this gate passes, but the category is full

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: Crowded, not a swarm: 12 of 28 brands are new in the last two months, and the biggest shops are all over a year old

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic with adhesive used near the eye: needs EU/UK cosmetic safety assessment and registration before selling

angles: Lashes for glasses wearers: lengths that don't touch the lenses
Gym and swim lashes: sweat-proof for workouts
Mature eyes: soft, light clusters for sparse lashes over 45
Bride and bridesmaid kit: one box for the whole party
TAKEN: "No more infills" salon-cost saving (Lola's main message)

compare.match_name: Lola's Lashes kit on Amazon UK (£20)
compare.note: Every exact match was Lola's own kit, sold by the brand or its stockists, including Lola's on Amazon UK at £20. No other seller makes this design.

products.advertiser_takeaway: Lola's Lashes leads: 147 of the first 250 ads are theirs, running since February. Behind them are established names (Unicorn Cosmetics, Tatti Lashes, imPRESS) with shops over a year old. It works, but it is a fight between real brands, not an open gap.

category_notes.au: The chain listings are rival brands (Ardell, GLAM by Manicare), not this kit.
category_notes.us: Target and Walmart sell rival brands (Ardell, KISS imPRESS), not this kit.
category_notes.uk: Superdrug and Boots sell Lola's own kit and rival brands.
category_notes.ca: Walmart and Shoppers Drug Mart sell rival brands (Ardell, QUO, KISS), not this kit.
category_notes.de: Douglas and Boozyshop sell rival kits; Boozyshop also sells Lola's own kit.
category_notes.nz: Chemist Warehouse sells GLAM by Manicare clusters, not this kit.

Same.head: Only the brand itself
Same.detail: Every exact match is Lola's own kit, sold by the brand or its stockists (Superdrug, Boozyshop, Amazon). Rival kits look different but are everywhere.
